def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    def comps(color):
        seen=set(); result=[]
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                if grid[r][c]!=color or (r,c) in seen: continue
                stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); p=[]
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop(); p.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]==color and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                            seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
                result.append(p)
        return result
    def norm(p):
        a=min(y for y,x in p); b=min(x for y,x in p)
        return frozenset((y-a,x-b) for y,x in p)
    # Long 9 L is the paint key. Use small 3 objects as shape exemplars;
    # recolor a matching 5 object in the L's open upper-left sector.
    nine=comps(9)
    if not nine: return out
    marker=max(nine,key=len)
    mr=min(y for y,x in marker); mc=min(x for y,x in marker)
    templates=[norm(p) for p in comps(3) if len(p)>=3 and len(p)<=8]
    candidates=[]
    for p in comps(5):
        if not all(y<mr and x<mc for y,x in p): continue
        shape=norm(p)
        for t in templates:
            if len(shape)!=len(t): continue
            variants=[]
            for k in range(4):
                q=set(shape)
                for _ in range(k): q={(x,-y) for y,x in q}
                for flip in (False,True):
                    z={(y,-x if flip else x) for y,x in q}
                    a=min(y for y,x in z); b=min(x for y,x in z)
                    variants.append(frozenset((y-a,x-b) for y,x in z))
            if t in variants:
                candidates.append(p); break
    if candidates:
        target=min(candidates,key=lambda p:min((mr-y)+(mc-x) for y,x in p))
        for y,x in target: out[y][x]=9
    return out
